description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing articles within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting articles, as well as private helper methods for related data fetching and processing.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Article
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing article-related actions and data within the Coocook project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list articles, fetching project data, and preparing article and unit data for display.

methods.name: new_article
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new article.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures the article by ID and stashes it for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for an existing article, including units in use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new article related to the project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing article with submitted data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an article if it is not in use.

methods.name: fetch_project_data
methods.description: Private method to fetch and stash project-related data such as shop sections and units.

methods.name: dishes_recipes
methods.description: Private method to collect related recipes linked to dishes and independent dishes, and stash them.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Private method to handle updating or inserting an article with validation and related data management.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the article index page.
